camel_example: aliyun ims ListUsers --region cn-hangzhou --Status active --Tag.1.Key operator --Tag.1.Value alice --Marker EXAMPLE --MaxItems 1000
description_en: Queries information about all Resource Access Management (RAM) users
description_zh: 查询所有RAM用户的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ims list-users --marker EXAMPLE --max-items 1000 --tag Value=alice Key=operator --status active --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en: The `marker`. If part of a previous response is truncated, you can use this parameter to obtain the truncated part
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，可以使用`Marker`获取从当前截断位置之后的内容。
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. If a response is truncated because it reaches the value of `MaxItems`, the value of `IsTruncated` will be true.

Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的条数。当返回结果达到`MaxItems`限制被截断时，返回参数`IsTruncated`将等于true。 

取值范围：1~1000。默认值：1000
parameters.name: max_items

fields.help_en:
The key of tag N.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. N must be consecutive
fields.help_zh:
标签键。

N的取值范围：1~20，N必须连续
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of tag N.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. N must be consecutive
fields.help_zh:
标签值。

N的取值范围：1~20，N必须连续
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. A maximum number of 20 tags are supported
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The status of the RAM users that you want to query. Valid values: active, freeze, and active,freeze. If you leave the parameter empty, the value active is used by default. If you specify a value for the Tag parameter, users in both states are queried
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询的用户状态，支持active，freeze状态。指定全部状态时使用逗号拼接，如：active,freeze。未指定状态时默认指定active状态。
当使用Tag标签时，默认查询全部状态的用户
parameters.name: status

IsTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the response is truncated. Valid values:

true

false
IsTruncated.description_zh:
请求返回结果是否被截断。取值：

true
false

Marker.description_en: The parameter that is used to obtain the truncated part. It takes effect only when `IsTruncated` is set to `true`
Marker.description_zh: 此参数在`IsTruncated`为`true`时生效，用于获取截断后的内容

User.description_en: The information about the RAM users

items.description_en: The information about the RAM user

Comments.example: This is a cloud computing engineer.

CreateDate.description_en: The point in time when the RAM user was created. The time is displayed in UTC

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the RAM user

Email.description_en:
The email address of the RAM user.

This parameter applies only to the Alibaba Cloud China site (aliyun.com)
Email.description_zh:
RAM用户的电子邮箱。

该参数仅适用于中国站

LastLoginDate.description_en: The timestamp when the RAM user last logged on to the console
LastLoginDate.description_zh: RAM用户最近一次登录控制台的时间（时间戳）

MobilePhone.description_en:
The mobile phone number of the RAM user.

This parameter applies only to the Alibaba Cloud China site (aliyun.com)
MobilePhone.description_zh:
RAM用户的手机号码。

该参数仅适用于中国站

ProvisionType.description_en:
The source of the RAM user. Valid values:

Manual: The RAM user is manually created in the RAM console.

SCIM: The RAM user is mapped by using System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM).

CloudSSO: The RAM user is mapped from a CloudSSO user
ProvisionType.description_zh:
同步类型。取值：
Manual：在RAM中手动创建的RAM用户。
SCIM：通过SCIM协议同步创建的RAM用户。
CloudSSO：通过云SSO同步创建的用户

Status.description_en: The status of the RAM user

UpdateDate.description_en: The point in time when the information about the RAM user was last modified. The time is displayed in UTC

UserId.description_en: The ID of the RAM user

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the RAM user
